newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai Aluminium threatens French machinery boycott.
newsitem.headline: Dubai Aluminium threatens French machinery boycott.

text.p: Dubai Aluminium Co (Dubal) is considering boycotting French machinery until Paris acts to lift a six percent EU tariff on aluminium imports, Dubal vice-chairman Mohammad Alabbar was quoted as saying on Wednesday.
"We are not buying any technology from France," the Gulf Today newspaper quoted him as saying.
Alabbar, mentioning in particular French aluminium group Pechiney, said Dubal would start buying equipment from other sources, such as Britain.

"We could go for purchasing equipment from Britain because it is not in favour of the European (tariff) and wants to end (it)," the Gulf News quoted him as saying. "The French should not be scared of fair competition." he added.
Pechiney licenses aluminium and alumina smelting technology, knowhow and equipment and makes and sells smelter equipment through a subsidiary.
Aluminium Pechiney head Bernard Legrand chairs the European Aluminium Association, which supports the six percent tariff.

Legrand recently said the duty would be maintained because it allowed European producers to compete against cheap imports from Russia and the Gulf and it compensated European producers for dollar fluctuations.
